Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street 1 block to Kits Beach, this rare 2-level, 1,499 sq ft townhome sits in an exclusive 4-unit boutique strata. Bright layout features 2 beds, den w/ soaring vaulted ceilings, 2 full baths & multiple skylights. Main level offers open-concept kitchen/dining & private deck. Upper level features an airy living room, balcony & generous primary bed. Enjoy a SPECTACULAR PRIVATE ROOFTOP DECK with breathtaking views of the ocean, mountains & skyline. Includes 1 covered carport. Steps to Kits Beach, saltwater pool, tennis courts, Vanier Park & vibrant W 4th/Cornwall dining & shops. Easy transit to Downtown & UBC! If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent.

This stunning Kitsilano gem is an absolute must see! 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathroom main level features a perfect layout for your family. Main floor contains a spacious living/dining area with cozy gas fireplace, natural hard wood flooring, large windows for plenty of natural light, clean neutral wall tones. A chef's dream of a kitchen! Plenty of storage within the wood cabinetry, large center island with stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and surrounding windows. Primary and secondary bedrooms are located on the main level with one bathroom and a ensuite to the primary. Downstairs holds the third bedroom, full bathroom, private laundry, and a large 4th bedroom (no closet) /could also be used as a rec room/office/ kids play area- the options are endless!

A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.
